notes.content:

-Combat Systems & Skills System

-Archery System

-Blocking System

-Fluid Animations and optimization of the bugs.

notes.title: Welcome to the Realm of Emperial Knights !
notes.content:
Welcome to the Realm of Emperial Knights !

You have vainquished the Tower of Infinite, you have proven your skills and valor in combat. Now it's time to prepare for the adventure to come !

For the next update, there will be a big open world adventure to explore and progress alone or with your friends via Steam.



-New Questing System
-New first step tutorial
-New World Map
-New Challenges & Content
-Class Balance
-Parkour any obstacle
-Mount System.
